column1: # Phase 1 UAT — Extraction Accuracy Ground-Truth Template
# One row per EXPECTED invoice. For multi-invoice PDFs
# and keep sourceFileName identical (rows are disambiguated by invoiceNumber).
# Column meaning:
#   testCaseId      Any unique label for the row (e.g. TP-001).
#   sourceFileName  The uploaded file name EXACTLY as it appears in the app.
#   invoiceNumber   Expected invoice number (also used to match multi-invoice PDFs).
#   vendorRawName   Expected vendor name as printed on the document.
#   invoiceDate     Expected invoice date (any common format; normalized on compare).
#   dueDate         Expected due date. Provide dueDate OR paymentTerms (at least one).
#   paymentTerms    Expected payment terms (e.g. "Net 30") if no explicit due date.
#   poNumber        Expected PO number — leave blank if not present on the document.
#   subtotal        Expected subtotal — leave blank if not present.
#   taxAmount       Expected tax — leave blank if not present.
#   freightAmount   Expected freight/shipping — leave blank if not present.
#   totalAmount     Expected grand total (always required).
#   currency        Expected ISO currency (e.g. USD).
# Leave a cell blank to skip scoring that optional field. Required-always fields:
# vendorRawName
# dueDate/paymentTerms.
# Delete these comment lines and the example row below
testCaseId
